name: Being Kind
overview: Scripture reveals that being kind is an expression of love rooted in the goodness of God, who shows kindness even to the unthankful and evil. Christ teaches us to treat others as we would want to be treated and to love our neighbors as ourselves, reflecting the fruit of the Spirit such as gentleness and goodness. True kindness involves putting away bitterness and anger, embodying a heart transformed by God's longsuffering and goodness that leads to repentance.
